title: Celsius CEO discloses 18,000-share purchase
postText: Celsius CEO John Fieldly just bought 18,000 $CELH shares at an average price of $27.44.
mirroredFacts: Celsius Holdings CEO John Fieldly purchased 18,000 common shares on September 10, 2026.
The SEC Form 4 reports a weighted-average purchase price of $27.4357 per share, rounded to $27.44.
